_comment: Options of `python3 -m pianovision accompaniment` (Note Waterfall's companion audio rendered by MuseScore
with Muse Sounds). Keys of 'scores' are score paths relative to the scores folder; 'defaults' apply to all.
Only the render copies are changed, never the scores, and never a note.
mute_vocals       mute vocal staves (instrumentId voice.*), default true
piano_orchestral  'auto' (muted when the score also has the orchestra), 'mute' or 'play'
mute_parts        Part ids to mute as well; play_parts: Part ids to play although they would be muted
reset_reverb      drop the reverb sends saved for the basic sounds (Muse Sounds' own levels), default true
relabel           [{part, from, to, instrumentId, why}]: the Part's instrument 'from' (its id attribute, or an
instrument it changes to) plays as 'to' (a MuseScore instrument id) with that instrumentId;
see `python3 -m pianovision accompaniment --list` for the Part ids
techniques        [{part, technique, text, why}]: the part's staves start with that playing technique
(MuseScore's playTechType, e.g. 'pizzicato'; 'text' is what it shows)
